updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.5.13 
- Fix F-14 Mini Wheel unchecked nreaking IC. 
- Update F-14 Jester scripts to release version. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 command remapping Radar, Air to ground,  Air to air, Weapons selection and fuzing. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 new crew contract commands. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 new Air to Ground Commands, JDAM and GGW options. 
- Fix F-14 Jester 1.5 Radar active/standby, elevation and azimuth commands 
- Adds check of module prior to sending AIRIO command 
- Performance improvements and additional logging for process server data 
- F-14 AIRIO new radar elevation commands (replace old ones to allow more options) 
- F-14 AIRIO Navigation commands fix A/B and Add B(U) logic and increase steepoint numbers to 14. 
- F-14 AIRIO New Commands for B(U) Direct Steepoint X, Nav Mode and Flight Plan management. 
- More process update performance tweaks. 
- F-14 AIRIO Fix Scan Hi commands. 
- F-14 AIRIO add TID Expand/Collapse commands 
- Add new Defensive Commands for F-14B(U) AIRIO, CMDS Modes, Manual Program selection, Inhibits, RWR Types and Jammer functions. 
- F-14 AIRIO Command catagory update and refactor new catagories Lantirn, D-Link and Nav/Utility. 
- Add JDAM support for F-14B(U) weapons selection 
- New GGW commands for Pre Planned to All and Pre Planned to Station number. 
- New Map Marker to NavGrid for F-14B(U). 
- F-14 Mini Wheel checkbox now adds new Wheel visibility code and handling, no more wheel flash when executing commands.(breaks IC). 
- F-14B(U) Link commands added and fixed Radio Tune command path. 
- Adds F-14 update profile deployment to startup/reset flow. 
- Updates AIRIO labels and hints from Scan Range to TID Range. 
- Adjusts Tomcat A/B and B(U) datalink and radar sector handling. 
- Switches embedded .vap resources to byte arrays to preserve profile integrity.
